limitations: This file is the refresh layout template; datasources/refresh.py generates a pinned sources.json for each imports run.
Catalog original/community metadata is a retained claim, not independent verification.

GitHub and CurseForge community sources include Ukrainian, Czech, Polish, Swedish, Italian and Turkish datasets; see datasources/README.md for the active registry. CurseForge sources discover the latest approved public Forever release without API credentials.
Locally authored AI text is excluded from the reference index and retained in complete entity packets.

Questie English text uses composed static exports; quest fields and NPC names compose base and per-field traces. Item names retain base lookups; differing or trace-only observations are flagged unverifiedItemNameTrace.
Blizzard supplies quest titles and descriptions; Questie supplies summaries and missing titles. EG Link is used only for NPC and item text.
Blizzard's resolved API namespace is independent of the current client build; Italian and English fallbacks are not accepted as native translations.
Wago exports may contain English or other-language fallback; flagged rows require inspection.
Language collision heuristics do not establish linguistic correctness or completeness.
Danish/Croatian and AI-only community fields may have no reference candidates; no translations are generated.
No in-game scan is imported by this configuration.
Classic and other-server translations are context candidates, not proof of Forever applicability.
Italian QuestIT data retains its separate translation licence; unidentified or conflicting licence grants are flagged context-only.
